'''Intelligence Bureau Chief''' was a position held by members of [[Alliance Intelligence/Legends|Alliance Intelligence]] who ran operations on [[Planet/Legends|planets]]. [[Milo Thirk]] was the Intelligence Bureau Chief for the [[Bespin system/Legends|Bespin system]].<ref name="SWS" />
